proposals.conflicts: None on identity. Current catalog uses integer rounding 88 g; manufacturer published 3.1 oz (87.9 g). Catalog Cd 1.55 is midpoint of manufacturer stated range 1.5-1.6.

source.title: Iris 30" Ultralight Parachute - 2.6lb @ 15fps - Fruity Chutes Inc

proposals.identityRationale: The source cited in the proposal is for IFC-30-SUL (Iris Ultralight). However, catalog part ifc-030-sl with packed_diam 1.9 in, packed_length 3.2 in, and weight 45 g corresponds to manufacturer model IFC-30-SL (Iris Light, 46 g, 1.9 in x 3.2 in). IFC-30-SUL is a distinct 38 g, 1.5 in x 4.2 in model.
proposals.conflicts: Conflation of two distinct manufacturer lines: 'Iris Light' (IFC-30-SL) and 'Iris Ultralight' (IFC-30-SUL). In addition, the 1.5 in x 4.2 in dimensions assume deployment bag packing density (0.18 oz/cu in); traditional fold is 0.13 oz/cu in.
proposals.dispositionEvidence: Applying 1.5 in to ifc-030-sl overwrites the valid dimensions of the IFC-30-SL part with dimensions from the IFC-30-SUL variant. IFC-30-SUL should be introduced as a separate catalog part if desired, rather than destroying ifc-030-sl.
proposals.rollbackRequirements: Retain existing value 1.9 in. Invariant check must prevent cross-variant overwrites.
